title: Parity families and signed spectra: kernel averaging, near-Ramanujan bounds, and exact circulant models
summary: We develop an affine $\mathbb F_2$ framework for structured signings of regular graphs. A family-averaging identity converts even spectral moments into parity-weighted closed-walk counts supported on the span of prescribed short even cycles, while a kernel-averaged Ihara identity gives the corresponding decomposition at the non-backtracking level.
